China rebalancing to robotics and persistent iron ore downside thesis; Xi under fire signals policy uncertainty

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound as RBA rate fears counterbalance global tech/AI strength. Iron ore weakness and diesel supply concerns cap upside. Key watch: RBA governor commentary and Trump-Xi meeting outcomes.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural shift in China demand (iron ore to robotics) pressures ASX materials weight. Gold, critical minerals, and tech offer relative outperformance. Housing correction and fiscal constraints cap financials/REITs. Diversification away from commodity concentration is essential.
